notes: Court Order of May 30, 2025 (Hon. Lina P. Corriston, J.S.C.) established rehabilitation obligation of 40 and Fourth Round prospective need of 334. Township Resolution 2025-82 committed to these obligations. HEFSP originally adopted June 25, 2025; submitted to State Affordable Housing Dispute Resolution Program. Plan challenged by both FSHC and New Jersey Builders Association (NJBA). Mediation Agreement with FSHC signed December 22, 2025, requiring amendment to plan (change of 6 dwelling units). Planning Board voted on ordinances 2066-2074 for consistency review March 11, 2026. Ordinance 2064 repealed and replaced Chapter 77 (Affordable Housing). Township uses 7 overlay zones plus mandatory set-aside ordinance to meet 93-affordable-unit target (25% of 334 prospective need = 84 required; plan yields 93). Abma Farm tract (still active family farm) has had inclusionary zoning since 1990s but remains undeveloped. RDP of 46 units cited in prior-round context. Block 259 Lots 1 and 2 (Franklin Avenue) has overlay via Ordinance 1896 for ~22 total / 3 affordable rental units at 12 du/acre with 15% set-aside.
